changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Reimport eligible GPS source files once after the GPS continuity, denoising, and energy changes. Startup recovery processes SCHEDULED files even when their size and modification time are unchanged. Retain existing tracks for the normal transactional replacement and preserve removed/excluded files.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE indexed_file AS indexed SET indexer_status = 'SCHEDULED', index_update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_message = 'Upgrade: GPS derived data rebuild scheduled', version = COALESCE(indexed.version, 0) + 1 WHERE indexed.index = 'GPS' AND (indexed.indexer_status IS NULL OR indexed.indexer_status NOT IN ('REMOVED', 'EXCLUDED'));
